scientific_purpose: Before aligning historical queries or changing architecture, compare actual trained and untrained 99390-parameter original associative query to event ORIGINAL WRITE-key oracle recovery and genuine same-source wrong-key matched control; source source-write residual sizes versus intervening median writes, shuffled-query null; station episode block bootstrap and pre-event covariate checks on fixed original 24-pair cohort.
source: Original UCI501 Beijing physical station data via immutable source Git commit 6e01290ddf3f10d298c4bcf463a219c9728c0565; only May–June2014 original FIT source, no2015 exposed or protected2016-2017 numeric.
cohort: Exact 24 registered LATFUSE008 May–June2014 same station+hour actual high raw PM2.5>=150 ug/m3 vs <=35 ug/m3, 2 seeds original assoc original checkpoints; paired same recorded cases across seeds; no new case selection or labels based on model outputs.
models: Two original SHA-pinned trained associative LATFUSE008 checkpoints seeds80701/80702 plus their model initial untrained seed versions and two extra deterministic untrained init seed 81901/81902. An untrained model tests whether inverse pair scoring is initialization/data-construction artifact, NOT a qualified learning comparison.
oracle_key_definition: Historical anchor original learned L2-normalized 2×8D write key (from actual source encoder, not inserted into ordinary future learned query); read original source state matrix with that key at delay. Compare oracle read vector cosine to original source-write value16, matched wrong historical write key/value from other member of same station/hour control pair. This is a privileged analysis-only query unavailable to online deployment.
null: Shuffled currently learned query across original other source samples in original case order by circular source pair shift, SNR event original matrix difference projected vs the rest; original native query vs shuffled. No arbitrary simulated label.
writes: Exact original source-conditioned per-head beta (v-alpha M k) kT residual write Frobenius magnitude at event time versus median observed future per-step true-source residual writes at each delay. Separate alpha retention effect. No authorization/event target used to alter writes.
statistics: Report original 24 paired signed ranks by initialization/training status and lag, exact binomial p uncorrected with explicit multiple-testing note, 95% seed/site-episode cluster bootstrap intervals (resample source station ids, fixed 4000 reps seeded12012), paired descriptive pre-event 24h raw PM2.5 history/date separation and centered ridge regression on score difference; do not treat station episode samples as fully independent due regional weather.
safeguards: All original trained checkpoints SHA unchanged; initial untrained versions never checkpoint-promoted or optimized; all model original source state 6800bytes unchanged, no synthetic here, zero optimizer updates, source-truth label accessed only after frozen model read, genuine current/historical source owner and authorized masks preserved. Findings are FIT-era exposed diagnostic, not statistically independent population efficacy.
stopping: Failure of source SHA/cohort SHA or any checkpoint, numeric nonfinite, mixed owner/masks, data leak or missing source stops instead of improvising a new cohort. No architecture change or new original neural training.
